purpose: Rapidly falsify or support the structural-node representation before any further long training: test whether a causal five-frame set of incident swept-superellipse ports remains identifiable across approach directions without node identity, primitive identity, absolute pose or world identity in the descriptor.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: 70 topology parents; three geometry realizations are repeated measures and are never counted as independent parents
sampling.rule: Use the final five-frame causal window of every directed traversal; sample source frames at 1 m arc spacing and keep the three geometry realizations as repeated measures within each topology parent.

raw_sources: sealed P1a realized construction programs and traversal manifest
sealed P1b five-frame primitive geometry/visibility/support shards
source.license_or_allowed_use: Project-generated research assets; upstream redistribution conditions remain unchanged.

teacher.source: Program construction endpoint compositions supply node labels and select incident ports only for this explicit upper-bound audit.
teacher.student_boundary: The emitted descriptor contains only normalized local port shape, curvature, support and pairwise angular relations. Node/primitive/world identity and absolute pose are scoring metadata only and never descriptor values.
teacher.valid_mask: A port is valid in five-frame mode only when present in primitive_mask; in the single-frame ablation it must additionally be visible in the current temporal_visibility row. Empty observations are invalid rather than negative.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or planner runs in this audit. Traversal-only edge consistency is deferred until the learned node representation passes C07 and then C08.

split.fit: Threshold is selected only on C01-C06 at precision >=0.98 with tie-safe grouping.
split.selection: The selected threshold is applied once to C07 without adaptation.
split.strict_test: C09/C10 and M-TARE are not read.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Historical endpoint-model predictions, checkpoints, graph results and planner outcomes are not inputs; only sealed P1a construction and P1b geometry/visibility are read.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.fit: Causal five-frame mode must have a nonempty tie-safe operating point with precision >=0.98 and recall >=0.25.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.selection: At the frozen fit threshold C07 precision must remain >=0.98, false accepts <=1% of accepted pairs, recall >=0.25 and every one of S01-S10 must contain at least one true positive.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.upper_bound: Full-composition oracle must expose a nonempty precision>=0.98 region; otherwise the representation is intrinsically ambiguous and training stops.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.determinism: All pair distances and labels are digested in deterministic task/mode order.

graph_consistency_corrective.trigger: The sealed V1R local descriptor produced 2960 TP and 53 FP on C07; accepted-pair false fraction 0.017590 exceeded the preregistered 0.01 limit even though its incomplete executor printed PASS.
graph_consistency_corrective.fixed_candidate_gate: Reuse the previously established 16 m graph-position candidate radius; it is not selected on C07 and node identity remains scoring-only.
graph_consistency_corrective.robustness: Require the same result under adversarial independent position errors bounded by 1 m per node, which can change pair separation by at most 2 m.
graph_consistency_corrective.acceptance: C07 precision >=0.99, accepted-pair false fraction <=0.01, recall >=0.25, all ten families with TP, and zero false accepts in the bounded-error check.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only; no neural inference or optimization

failure_policy: Any source drift, missing traversal/node composition, nonfinite geometry, C07 gate failure or determinism failure stops this candidate before training. Do not lower precision, inspect C08 or repair with graph rules.
retention: Keep the compact summary, source/tool hashes, environment, log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal; no duplicate sensor shards.

approval.scope: One immutable zero-training C01-C07 structural-node evidence funnel; zero C08-C10, graph, planner or M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution, optimal in-scope choices and no routine approval prompts.
